title: elymus pubiflorus
intro: Elymus pubiflorus, commonly known as Wild Brome, is a species of grass native to the mountainous regions of China. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Elymus pubiflorus include reducing inflammation, improving immune function, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
